title: An Introduction
text:
Hi! My name is Kiet but I usually go by Kevin. I am a senior in high school and I have chosen CS as my major for the next four years. Truth is, I have already started this journey a long time ago. Formally, it was last December that I entered an AI/ML course. Throughout that time period, I have come to realize how important it was to be able to write down your thoughts. It doesn’t only serve as a way to note things down but it is the most effective way for me to organize and actually grasp the materials.
And that brings us here. Writing is something I’m still not used to since English is my second language, but I hope this series of posts will be continued throughout college or even longer. The posts should mainly revolve around topics I found interesting in tech, AI or ML.
Cheers to many more posts to come! (hopefully)
